_: The knobs that shape behaviour and travel WITH THE BUILD. Edit, then build again.
_defaults: Any key may be missing: Tuning.kt's default is used and DictLog says which.

search._: MEASURED with tools/measure_query_cost.py over the real packs. See SearchTuning.

display._forms: The six of a conjugation table. Possible keys: ind1s ind2s ind3s ind1p ind3p pret1s pret3s sub1s part ger past pl fem
display._forms2: Adding 'pl' and 'fem' gives nouns and adjectives their Forms section back; 'past' gives it back to English verbs.
display._gloss: OFF. Uncomment to open up the leading of glosses that have links, as a multiple of
display._gloss2: the font size. It doubles the band a tap resolves inside (2.8 measured ~40px -> 79px)
display._gloss3: and costs a sense about half its visible lines, which is why it is off. See P-11.
